# paperclip_secret (Resource)

Manages a Paperclip secret in a company.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "paperclip_secret" "api_token" {
  company_id    = paperclip_company.acme.id
  name          = "forge-token"
  key           = "forge_token"
  description   = "Forge API token"
  provider_type = "local_encrypted"
  value         = var.forge_token
  rotation      = "2026-10"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_id` (String) The Paperclip company ID.
- `name` (String) Secret identifier name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional secret description.
- `external_ref` (String) External vault reference string. Required for external_reference secrets; prohibited for paperclip_managed secrets.
- `key` (String) Optional native secret key.
- `last_rotated_at` (String) Timestamp when the secret was last rotated, reflecting remote rotations as drift. When specified in configuration, detects out-of-band rotations as plan drift.
- `latest_version` (Number) The latest secret revision version number reported by Paperclip. When specified in configuration, detects out-of-band rotations as plan drift.
- `managed_mode` (String) Secret managed mode: paperclip_managed or external_reference.
- `provider_config_id` (String) Optional vault provider configuration identifier.
- `provider_metadata` (String) Optional JSON metadata object for the secret provider backend.
- `provider_type` (String) Secret provider backend: local_encrypted, aws_secrets_manager, gcp_secret_manager, or vault.
- `provider_version_ref` (String) Optional provider-specific version reference.
- `rotation` (String) Optional non-secret rotation identifier. Change it together with value to perform exactly one secret update; omission preserves the last applied identifier so the same rotation cannot be replayed.
- `status` (String) Administrative secret status: active, disabled, or archived.
- `value` (String, Sensitive, Write-Only) Optional write-only secret plaintext value. It must be supplied together with rotation for paperclip_managed secrets and is never persisted in plan or state. Prohibited for external_reference secrets.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the secret.
